Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.videoconference

Class ConferenceRoom

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.videoconference.ConferenceRoom
public class ConferenceRoom extends Object
A saved video-conference room. A room is nothing more than a name on a conferencing domain (by default a Jitsi Meet deployment): two people who agree on the same domain + name land in the same meeting, so a room bean is a lightweight, shareable handle rather than a server-side entity.

The bean is a plain Jackson-serializable POJO (no AWT, no Java 3D) so the whole model layer stays unit-testable headless and can be persisted by VideoConferenceStore. Per-room overrides (moderator, lock, mute-on- join) default to "inherit from settings" so the common case needs no configuration.
